This is censorship and access restriction, not protection of information freedom.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"Russia bans Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty as “undesirable”","publisher":"Committee to Protect Journalists","date":"2024-02-21","url":"https://cpj.org/2024/02/russia-bans-radio-free-europe-radio-liberty-as-undesirable/","summary":"CPJ reports that Russian authorities added RFE/RL to the “undesirable” register, obstructing a major independent broadcaster and treating journalism itself as a hostile activity.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3"]},{"title":"Russia to block leading foreign media outlets in retaliation against EU","publisher":"Committee to Protect Journalists","date":"2024-06-26","url":"https://cpj.org/2024/06/russia-to-block-leading-foreign-media-outlets-in-retaliation-against-eu/","summary":"Russia blocked access to 81 European media outlets, including AFP, Der Spiegel, Le Monde, and public broadcasters, in retaliation for EU restrictions.
